title: Water Djinn Essence

{{Item infobox | type = [[Trophy]] | value = 20 {{gold}} | campaign = [[Guild Wars Nightfall|Nightfall]] | collector = [[Jidun]]
[[Mirmahk]]
[[Nicholas the Traveler]] | commonsalvage = 1-2 [[Pile of Glittering Dust|Piles of Glittering Dust]] | raresalvage = 1 [[Sapphire]] | render = [[File:Sapphire Djinn Essence.jpg|150px]] }} [[Water Djinn Essence]]s are the essences of water-based [[Djinn]]. They can attract underground water from a wide distance. It is also used in recipes. [[Jidun]] says that it will help remove the effects of a mind-control potion, however [[Paljab]] claims that it is an ingredient for mind-controlling. ==Acquisition== *[[Guild Wars Nightfall|Nightfall]] ** [[Istan]] *** [[Haioss, Blessed Wind]] *** [[Water Djinn]] ** [[Kourna]] *** [[Maelstrom Djinn]] *** [[Sehlon, Beautiful Water]] *** Water Djinn {{ongoing item research}} ===Farming=== {{section-stub}} ====Turai's Procession==== [[File:Djinn-Turais.jpg|thumb|alt=Farming route for water djinn essence in Turai's Procession|Farming route for water djinn essence in Turai's Procession]] Start from The Gate of Desolation. Head south through Turai's Procession. Proceed through the winding path. Lots of water Djinn in the area. Due to the large amount of enemies in between the entrance and the farming location it may be best to use a [[Hero]] team to reach the spot before flagging them away upon reaching the farming spot. ====Mehtani Keys==== This is the quickest method for a total of eleven level 15 water djinn and nothing else close to an outpost. However, it requires a considerable setup:
* A party member with the quest [[War Preparations (Wind and Water)]] active, which one of the last Elonian-only [[primary quest]]s. * A fitting build that can defeat the waves of Djinn. This means that without a partner to enter the area with, doing it with the Elonian character requires a sufficient level and skills suited for farming. Alernatively, a high level hero can be used for help. (For example, doing the quest [[Hole of Istan]] can unlock several level 20 heroes, including [[Vekk]] to gain access to elemental damage-based builds to quickly kill the djinn.) After the character with the quest has spoken to [[Captain Bolduhr]], enter Methani Keys and approach the five [[sailor]]s, avoiding the [[popup]] [[Mandragor]] that will appear when straying slightly north from the quest's path, as well as the [[Skale]] to the south hat will patrol near the target location. Once the sailors are approached, three level 15 [[Water Djinn]] will spawn, followed by a second wave of three and a third wave of five. The sailors do not have to survive for all djinn to spawn. Do not speak to [[Kinya Kela]], but rezone to reset the quest for another run. ==Collectors== {{:Jidun/Collector}} {{:Mirmahk/Collector}} {{:Nicholas the Traveler/Collector|19th October 2009 and 4th November 2013|Turai's Procession|1 [[Water Djinn Essence]]}} ==Notes== *The collector [[Jidun]] trades 1 Water Djinn Essence for items that sell for 30 {{gold}} to a merchant. This provides a return that is one and a half times more than just selling the trophies by themselves. [[Category:Profitable trophies]] {{Research needed| Do they really salvage into Sapphires? Need screenshot proof on talk page. }}
